setup: You are [[op_ing]] $\frac{[[a]]}{[[den]]}$ and $\frac{[[b]]}{[[den]]}$. The bottoms already match.

steps.say: When the denominators are the same you can add the numerators straight away: [[a]] + [[b]] = [[raw_num]].
The denominator [[den]] does not change — it is still the size of one whole, and adding parts of the same whole keeps the same whole.
